notes.title: Thanks for playing!
notes.content:
Well its been a few days since the release as our studios first PC game 'Filthy Lucre' and we are really pleased so-far with the feedback from you, our players! 

The team have read every comment and email, we have watched every video and now, we are looking to figure out what can be addressed in our first game update.

Stay tuned for details and thanks again for playing 'Filthy Lucre'

Fabrik Games
